caption.text:
Sometimes life only makes sense in hindsight. The endings that once broke you become the moments that redirected you. The delays that frustrated you become the things that protected you. The people you begged to stay become the reasons you learned how to finally choose yourself.

There are seasons of life where everything feels uncertain — where you question why things didn’t work out the way you hoped they would. But with time, you begin to realize that not every closed door was meant to hurt you. Some were meant to save you from settling. Some were meant to make room for a version of your life that fits you more honestly, more deeply, more beautifully.

And maybe growth is exactly that: learning to trust that clarity will eventually come, even when you cannot see it yet. Learning that peace often arrives quietly. Learning that some of the best things that ever happened to you first arrived disguised as endings. 🖤
